# Imperial Beach Community Clinic

> > Community healthcare provider serving Imperial Beach and Nestor neighborhoods in San Diego County since 1971

IB Clinic operates multiple health centers providing accessible healthcare services to the South Bay community, including the Imperial Beach Health Center and Nestor Community Health Center. The organization focuses on community-based primary care and patient-centered services.
